South Surrey White Rock Waterfront Homes: streets and boundaries

items.t: Waterfront here means two municipalities on Semiahmoo Bay: Marine Drive in White Rock, and Crescent Beach in Surrey.
White Rock's waterfront runs along Marine Drive between East Beach and West Beach, promenade between road and beach.
Semiahmoo First Nation lands sit south of White Rock; a provincial document records the reserve as 129.1 hectares, 1.6 km southeast of White Rock.

blocks.text: South Surrey White Rock Waterfront Homes: the housing stock

items.t: The Marine Drive homes face the White Rock Pier: built 1914/15, 470 metres long, torn in half in the December 20, 2018 storm and repaired for summer 2019.
Crescent Beach houses are built raised to a flood level: Surrey requires floodplain applications to meet a Flood Construction Level (FCL) of 3.30 m G.S.C. (geodetic).

blocks.text: South Surrey White Rock Waterfront Homes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Two zoning systems apply: White Rock Zoning Bylaw, 2024, No. 2506 (adopted June 27, 2024), and Surrey's rules at Crescent Beach — confirm the city first.
White Rock's Official Community Plan (OCP) Bylaw, 2017, No. 2220 includes a Waterfront Development Permit Area.
At Crescent Beach, a geotechnical engineer is required for all floodplain construction, and building below the FCL needs a Development Variance Permit (DVP) plus a title covenant.

blocks.text: South Surrey White Rock Waterfront Homes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The railway runs between Marine Drive homes and the beach: a single track, operating 24 hours a day, used by BNSF freight and Amtrak passenger trains.
Beach access crosses that railway at eight gated pedestrian crossings only: Bay, Anderson, Oxford and the Pier on West Beach; Cypress, Balsam, Ash and Finlay on East Beach.
Dogs are not allowed on the White Rock Pier at any time, per the City's Pier and Promenade page.

blocks.text: South Surrey White Rock Waterfront Homes: development and new projects

items.t: White Rock Pier rebuild, Marine Drive, City of White Rock: approval in principle under the federal Building Communities Strong Fund, with a federal contribution of $25,935,000. STATUS: funding approval in principle; read 2026-11-03.

Surrey Disaster Mitigation Adaptation Fund (DMAF) coastal works, Crescent Beach, City of Surrey: a November 3, 2025 report updates the Coastal Flood Adaptation Strategy (approved 2019), with Crescent Beach storm sewer phases 100% complete. STATUS: under way to March 31, 2028; read 2026-11-03.

items.t: Surrey's 2026 municipal tax total for residential (Class 1) is 1.84251 per $1,000 of assessed value, plus a $300 Capital Parcel Tax for Class 1.
Surrey's 2026 single-family flat rates are water $1,195 and sewer $1,661; garbage, recycling and organics collection is $344.08.

blocks.text: South Surrey White Rock Waterfront Homes: getting around

items.t: White Rock Centre is the waterfront's bus hub: TransLink route 321 runs to Surrey Central Station and route 351 to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line), per the City's Zoning Bylaw 2506 report.
Fifteen stops on routes 321 and 351 sit inside White Rock, mainly on Johnston Road, Thrift Avenue and Oxford Street, above Marine Drive.

blocks.text: South Surrey White Rock Waterfront Homes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check White Rock's OCP floodplain mapping: a City report describes an Ocean Floodplain level of 3.9 m geodetic and a Campbell River Floodplain level of 4.6 m, overlapping in the southeast corner — check current.
Check the Crescent Beach Floodplain map for the exact lot: the map, not the street, decides whether the 3.30 m FCL applies.

faq.q: Is a Crescent Beach house in a floodplain?
faq.a: Yes — check the lot against the Crescent Beach Floodplain map before offering. Surrey requires the 3.30 m G.S.C. Flood Construction Level, a geotechnical engineer for all floodplain construction, and Council approval plus a title covenant for any build below that level.

faq.q: Will trains whistle outside a Marine Drive home?
faq.a: Not routinely at the promenade crossings. Since January 29, 2020, BNSF crews have been under a general order not to sound horns at White Rock's eight promenade crossings, after 16 safety gates were installed; engineers still sound the horn for people or animals on the tracks.

faq.q: Which hospital serves a waterfront home here?
faq.a: Peace Arch Hospital in White Rock. Fraser Health lists it at 15521 Russell Avenue, White Rock, providing emergency, surgery and maternity care for White Rock and South Surrey residents, and states it is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in South Surrey White Rock?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in South Surrey White Rock?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
